'''TZ-33''' was a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] stationed on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], and was present during the [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|Second Battle of Felucia]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SWA-2011" /> TZ-33 oversaw the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] during the [[Second Battle of Felucia/Legends|Second Battle of Felucia]] when reinforcements arrived in a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|Separatist ship]]. He was in charge of General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous's]] [[Separatist outpost (Felucia)/Legends|droid outpost]] on Felucia. However, Republic [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TEs]] began firing on the outpost, whereupon TZ-33 ordered the gates of the outpost be lowered so that droids could be sent out to investigate. But it turned out to be a trap, and soon, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] stormed the compound and destroyed all the droids present. TZ-33 was also destroyed when [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] bisected him diagonally through his torso.

==Behind the scenes==
This tactical droid was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]]. His voice was unusual compared to other notable [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|tactical droids]].<ref name="PL" />
